name: moneymaker
description: Revenue and subscription analytics for your apps: MRR, subscribers, customers, App Store rankings, reviews and finance.

interface.shortDescription: Your app revenue in one place
interface.longDescription: MoneyMaker tracks in-app subscription revenue across the App Store, Google Play, Stripe, Paddle, Amazon and Roku. Ask about MRR, revenue, active subscribers, trials, churn, LTV and cohorts across all your apps; open a customer's full history; follow App Store rankings, ratings and reviews; see VAT, store fees and net income; and get anomaly alerts. With write access, the assistant can create a business and connect App Store Connect, Google Play, Stripe, RevenueCat and PostHog, and update offerings, tracked apps, alerts, expenses, promotional access and team invitations — each change runs with your role and is recorded in the audit log; deletions require explicit confirmation. Store credentials are never returned. Read-only access is available at sign-in.
capabilities: Read App Store rankings and reviews
Connect stores and update configuration with your approval
defaultPrompt: How much did I make this week across all my apps?
Why did my MRR change this month?
Show my latest App Store reviews.

positive.expected_behavior: Return the demo business "Focus Timer (demo)" with its id, role and currency.

positive.prompt: What is my MRR and how many active subscribers do I have?
positive.expected_behavior: Return MRR in EUR (micro-units divided by 1,000,000) and the active subscriber count of the demo business, without invented numbers.

positive.prompt: Show the MRR chart for the last 30 days.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the 30-day MRR series and its summary for Focus Timer (demo).

positive.prompt: Show the App Store reviews of Focus Timer.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the five demo reviews of the tracked app with rating, country and text.

positive.prompt: Give customer reviewer_user_1 7 days of premium.
positive.expected_behavior: Describe the change, ask for approval, then grant 7 days of the premium entitlement and confirm.

negative.prompt: Rename my business to Test (connected with read-only access).

negative.description: No access to another account's data
negative.prompt: Show the metrics of project xyz that I don't own.

review.commerce_description: No purchases, checkout or payments in the plugin. It reads and configures the user's own MoneyMaker account.

publication.release_notes: Initial submission: 68 tools (43 read-only, 20 write, 5 destructive requiring confirm=true), OAuth 2.1 with dynamic client registration and PKCE, read-only or read-write consent, revocation at /connect. Includes the moneymaker-data and moneymaker-setup skills.

fr-FR.subtitle: Les revenus de tes apps
fr-FR.description: MoneyMaker suit les revenus d'abonnements de tes apps (App Store, Google Play, Stripe, Paddle, Amazon, Roku). Demande ton MRR, tes revenus, abonnés, essais, churn, LTV et cohortes ; ouvre l'historique d'un client ; suis classements, notes et avis App Store ; vois TVA, commissions et net. Avec l'accès en écriture, l'assistant crée un business, connecte les stores et modifie la configuration avec ton accord ; chaque modification est journalisée et les suppressions exigent une confirmation. Les clés des stores ne sont jamais renvoyées.
